home.name: 便利店
home.en: a 24-hour convenience store on an empty road; the last clerk left a rules sheet

shouyinji.name: 收银机
shouyinji.en: the till: says 欢迎光临 in a flat, pleasant voice, and sometimes more

hongyi.name: 红雨衣
hongyi.en: a customer in a red raincoat: very polite, and always dry

siji.name: 司机
siji.en: a night taxi driver, a regular

dianzhang.name: 店长
dianzhang.en: the manager: never answers at night, arrives at six yawning

pang.name: 庞经理
pang.en: the store manager in 1998, an old man now
